_comment: Known divergences from upstream's obsolescence list, written by scripts/check-upstream-divergence.js --update. An entry is not necessarily a defect — the webapp is mirrored 1:1 on purpose — but every entry needs a `why`. A NEW divergence fails --strict.

entries.note: replaced by the frontend event cs_event-set_favicon - kept for backward compatibility.
entries.why: carried because the webapp is mirrored 1:1 from upstream by design (mirror-input.js takes app/webapp verbatim), so dropping it would mean forking the mirror. Upstream keeps these for ABAP installations that still reference them; this port has no installed base, so they are droppable in principle -- but only together with a decision to stop mirroring the frontend verbatim, which is a bigger call than removing one control. Listed so the choice stays visible rather than forgotten.
